svg.title: Recorded verification scope for Loop 1.10
svg.desc: Release c6255a1: two local final-export campaigns each passed 14 gates with 317 passed tests and one skip; 14 bundle journeys and all 53 skill payload installations were checked; four explicit-load model trials retain one failed original work trial and three passing artifact results. Native discovery, office engines and broad reliability remain untested. Four release CI jobs succeeded.
svg.text: EVIDENCE / 1.10.0-EXPERIMENTAL
What was checked, and at which layer?
Recorded release c6255a1 · Read the linked artifacts for exact inputs, dates and limits.
LOCAL GATES
Two final exports: 14/14 gates each
Python 3.12 / 3.14: 318 discovered; 317 PASS + 1 Windows symlink SKIP.
Structure + regressions
INSTALLATION
14 bundle journeys; 53 skills in three layouts
117 payloads per layout; 351 original backup byte comparisons passed.
Files + preservation
MODEL TRIALS
Four explicit-load calls, including a retained failure
Support PASS · Knowledge PASS · Work FAIL · Schema-explicit work PASS.
Fixed artifact criteria
NOT_RUN
Native discovery, office engines and broad reliability
No native picker/slash proof, formula recalculation or office artifact rendering.
Separate missing evidence
Release CI: 4/4 jobs succeeded on Ubuntu / Windows with Python 3.11 / 3.12.
These counts describe recorded checks. They are not an all-skill success rate or an A/B benchmark.
